BrochureContent.Content: Nicely Situated, Spacious 3 Bed Residence on c.1.4 Acres

Charming four-bedroom home is set on approximately 1.4 acres of beautiful grounds, offering picturesque views of the surrounding countryside. Built around two decades ago, the home is filled with natural light, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere. The location is highly convenient, with three towns accessible within a 20-minute drive. Drinagh Village, providing essential amenities such as a supermarket, hardware store, churches, school, and several pubs, is only a 20-minute walk from the property. 1 hours drive to Cork City & Aiport
The Lounge/diner is thoughtfully designed to maximize natural brightness, featuring numerous windows that flood the space with light. Two sets of French doors open directly onto the garden, seamlessly connecting the indoor living area with the outdoors and allowing for uninterrupted views of the grounds. A wood-burning stove serves as the centerpiece of the room, providing warmth and a cosy atmosphere throughout the year.
The kitchen is exceptionally well designed, occupying a central position within the home and serving as the heart of daily living. It is fully fitted and finished to a high standard, with an emphasis on maximizing natural light to create a bright and airy atmosphere. A convenient door leads directly from the kitchen to a separate utility room, providing additional space for laundry and storage needs, and enhancing the overall practicality of the living area. 
The ground floor includes a spacious master bedroom, which is again bright, light, and airy. The master benefits from an ensuite bathroom and a walk-in dressing room for added convenience. Additionally, there is another generously sized bedroom and a ground floor WC.
OUTSIDE
Accessed by a spacious stone driveway, the private garden covers around 1.6 acres and offers breathtaking elevated views of the countryside.  Mainly laid to lawn  with a sitting area which is perfect for relaxing and making the most of the glorious view. The garden, which can be accessed easily, is enclosed by mature trees, light woodland, shrubs, and wildflowers, creating a habitat that supports local wildlife.
The property includes a spacious outbuilding serving as a garage and workshop, with upstairs accommodation featuring a bedroom, kitchen, utility room, living area, and wet room. Behind the house is  an unfinished building suitable for conversion to stables, kennels, or storage.   A wooden studio sits between the house and garage/workshop.
